title: Curriculum Bank — tier-aware differentiator + topic-aware scaffolder + spec-point expansion
summary: Replace string-shuffle differentiation and regex-class scaffolding with curriculum-bank-backed pipelines. Foundation vs Higher differ at the spec-point level (use the existing tier field). Scaffolded versions pull per-spec-ref sentence frames + word banks + step ladders. Spec-point taxonomy expands from 3 datasets to 16 covering AQA + Edexcel + OCR for the top GCSE subjects across Y10 and Y11.
motivation: Today /api/ai/differentiate-worksheet rewords existing questions with no spec-ref or tier-subset awareness, and /api/ai/scaffold-worksheet's deterministic fallback emits regex-class hints keyed on punctuation rather than topic. Curriculum coverage is 3 datasets versus the ~120 needed for UK secondary. The user wants the three differentiated outputs (Foundation / Higher / Scaffolded) to be genuinely different, and questions to match what is actually taught in real GCSE classrooms.

in: client/src/data/exemplars/ — new directory with paraphrased exemplar bank seeds
client/src/data/scaffolds/ — new directory with per-spec-ref scaffolding seeds
client/src/lib/ai.ts — getSpecQuestions() consults bank with tier filter
Unit tests for new module + smoke for endpoints
out: Primary (White Rose Maths Y1–Y6, DfE NC) — Phase F2
Geography, history, MFL — Phase F2 (architecture ready)
Full-coverage exemplars (>1 per spec point) — Phase F2 densification

acceptance_criteria: Generating Foundation and Higher worksheets on the same topic on a board+subject covered by this PR produces output where the set of referenced specRefs differs by >= 30 percent.
Generating a Foundation worksheet on AQA Y10 Combined Science contains 0 questions whose specRef has tier="higher" in the underlying dataset.
Scaffolded version of a worksheet on a seeded topic uses the topic's actual word bank from the scaffold dataset, not the regex-extracted token list.
Every exemplar row has a non-empty source attribution.
Backwards compatible: existing public signatures of specPointTaxonomy module unchanged.
npm test passes; npm run check passes; npm run eval:worksheets passes with no fixture regressions.

risk_register.risk: PR is large (~16 new JSON files, 4 modified TS files, 2 new TS files, 2 modified docs)
risk_register.mitigation: Sequenced commits each compile green; SESSION-HANDOFF.md updated after every commit so a context-limit interruption is recoverable.

risk_register.risk: Dataset accuracy drift vs awarding-body specs
risk_register.mitigation: Each JSON file includes a 'source' field citing the specification document. Spec content is derived from public AQA/Edexcel/OCR specifications which are stable across years.
All exemplars are paraphrased, never verbatim. Each exemplar carries a 'source' field describing the paper it imitates without reproducing the wording.
The bank lookup is additive; getSpecQuestions still falls back to the existing topic banks when no bank entry exists. Run npm run eval:worksheets before push.

rollout.feature_flag: Defaults on. The new bank-aware path is layered over the existing prompt path so a runtime regression can be reverted by a single conditional.
rollout.monitoring: metadata.specRefsUsed and metadata.tierTargetMet are stamped by the post-validator and surfaced in the audit-trail panel.
